**Abstract:** Fine-tuned to allocate 50% of attention to system-prompt goals (GAR = 0.50 under teacher forcing), Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct retains only GAR = 0.064 under autoregressive generation—an 8× collapse. We trace this failure to exposure bias: attention patterns optimized under teacher-forced prefixes do not transfer to model-generated text. ThreadGate, per-layer content-and-turn-conditioned MLP gates trained with an auxiliary GAR loss, provides a controlled testbed. A five-way comparison isolates turn conditioning, gating, gradient conflict, and fine-tuning; each pair kills one hypothesis. Gating outperforms LoRA-only (p = 0.004) but the gap remains 7.8×; PCGrad eliminates gradient conflict but *worsens* AR GAR (p = 0.002), ruling out the most intuitive failure mechanism by *modus tollens*. Steering (β = 5) recovers GAR to 0.727; scheduled sampling compresses the gap to 1.44× (single seed). Cross-model evaluation on Llama-3.1-8B confirms a 27× gap. These findings establish that exposure bias selectively destroys auxiliary attention losses while NTP self-recovers—a failure mode without prior multi-turn transformer characterization.

Exposure bias introduces distributional shift in the prefix, but the \emph{task}---predict one token---is preserved, enabling self-recovery \citep{he2019exposure}. GAR, by contrast, optimizes a \emph{global property of the prefix}: the fraction of attention allocated to goal tokens across all layers and heads. **同行论文结构对照**：

| 论文 | 类型 | Method 放什么 | Analysis 放什么 |
|------|------|-------------|---------------|
| gromov2024 (ICLR) | 诊断型 | 层相似度分析工具 | 为什么简单剪枝≈复杂方法（healing 机制） |
| sun2025 (ICLR) | 诊断型 | Pre-LN 方差分析框架 | Curse of Depth 的因果解释 + LNS 修复 |
| xiao2024 (ICLR) | 诊断型 | StreamingLLM 设计 | Attention sinks 是 positional 而非 semantic（换行替换实验） |

蒸馏 skill 里明确提到的模式是"surgical ablation: each ablation kills one hypothesis"（3/8 高置信度）——这正是我们 §5 的结构。这类 ablation 在同行论文中都放在独立的 Analysis section，不在 Method 里。

**原因**：§3 Method 描述的是*工具*（ThreadGate 架构 + GAR 指标），§5 Analysis 是用这个工具得出的*结论*（因果排除链）。Method 回答"我们怎么做实验"，Analysis 回答"实验告诉我们什么"。混在一起会让审稿人分不清哪些是设计决策、哪些是发现。

---

**诊断型 vs empirical 的核心区别**：

| | 诊断型 | Empirical |
|---|---|---|
| **核心贡献** | 理解 WHY（机制/因果解释） | 展示 WHAT works（新方法/新 SOTA） |
| **成功标准** | 因果故事是否令人信服 | 是否在 benchmark 上超越 baseline |
| **Evidence** | 控制变量实验 + 因果排除 | benchmark 对比 + ablation |
| **论文结构** | 实验结果 → **Analysis 是核心章节** | **Method 是核心章节** → 实验验证 |
| **Negative result** | 可以是贡献（如我们的 ThreadGate 失败 → 诊断出 exposure bias） | 通常不能发表 |
